notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Exchange 14068 South 145 East Development Agreement Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on August 30, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Exchange 14068 South 145 East Development Agreement Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the below bodies 
to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 14068 S. 145 East. The purpose of the request is to modify Draper City Municipal Code Title 9 standards to allow a building up to 60-feet in height and allow alternative architectural and parking standards. The request will allow a building to be built in the existing Exchange at 140th office complex which better aligns with what has already been built in the complex.

-	Planning Commission: September 10, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. 
-	City Council: September 15, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.

Both hearings will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Jennifer Jastremsky at Draper City offices, jennifer.jastremsky@draperutah.gov & 801-576-6328.

Dated this 27th Day of August, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA


Thursday, August 27, 2026, 6:30 PM

1020 East Pioneer Road

Draper, UT 84020

Council Chambers

6:30 PM BUSINESS MEETING

1.	Items for Commission Consideration

1.a Action Item: Approve Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for July 30, 2026. (Administrative Action)

Approval of Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for July 30, 2026.

1.b Action Item: Approve Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for August 13, 2026. (Administrative Action)

Approval of Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for August 13, 2026.

1.c Public Meeting: Camden Park Subdivision Phase 1 Amended Plat Request (Administrative Item)

On the request of Philip & Shelli Rosbach & The Weaver Family Trust, a Subdivision Plat Amendment Request for approximately 0.62 acres, located at 11446 S Camden Rd. & 11464 S. Camden Rd. Known as application 2026-0162-USE. Staff Contact: Nick Whittaker, (801) 576-6522, nick.whittaker@draperutah.gov.

1.d Public Hearing: Rusty's Pitmasters Barbecue, LLC. Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit Request (Administrative Action)

On the request of Russell Stephenson, representing Rusty's Pitmasters Barbecue, LLC. A Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit Request on approximately 0.64 acres, located at 1645 E. Richins Rd. Known as application 2026-0162-USE. Staff Contact: Nick Whittaker, (801) 576-6522, nick.whittaker@draperutah.gov.

1.e Public Hearing: Wise Flooring Site Plan and Parking Deviation Requests (Administrative Action)

On the request of Mitch Cordner, representing Savio Rentals, a site plan to construct a retail building, with a deviation from strict compliance for required parking on approximately 1.08 acres, located at 41 W. Ikea Way. Known as applications 2026-0033-SP and 2026-0190-VAR. Staff Contact: Nick Whittaker, (801) 576-6522, nick.whittaker@draperutah.gov.

2.	Other Business
 
2.a Coordination between City Staff and Planning Commission (as needed).

3.	Adjournment

I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper Planning Commission meeting to be held August 27, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.


Nicole Smedley, CMC, City Recorder Draper City, State of Utah
